exposure: trial of labor after cesarean delivery (TOLAC)
cohort: Pregnant women in Japan with one prior cesarean section, delivering a singleton by cephalic presentation between 37 and 41 weeks of gestation.
finding: The trial of labor after cesarean delivery (TOLAC) rate in Japan was 5.0%, which is considerably lower than reported in other countries, despite comparable complication rates.
mod_finding: Among women attempting TOLAC, 88.6% achieved successful vaginal births, with a uterine rupture rate of 0.46%.
